description.zh:
SQL任务ID，可通过调用接口[GetDataCorrectTaskDetail](~~208481~~)和[ListDBTaskSQLJob](~~207049~~)获取该参数的值。
> 如果type = SINGLE，需要传递JobId确认需要重试的SQL任务ID。
description.en:
The ID of the SQL task. You can call the [GetDataCorrectTaskDetail](~~208481~~) or [ListDBTaskSQLJob](~~207049~~) operation to obtain the value of this parameter.

>  If Type is set to SINGLE, you must pass in the value of JobId to confirm the ID of the SQL task that you want to pause.

description.zh: 数据变更工单ID，可通过调用接口[ListOrders](~~144643~~)获取该参数的值。
description.en: The ID of the data change ticket. You can call the [ListOrders](~~144643~~) operation to query the ID of the data change ticket.

description.zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口[GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~)获取该参数的值。
description.en: The tenant ID. You can call the [GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~) operation to query the tenant ID.

description.zh:
暂停类型，取值如下：

- ALL：全部暂停
- SINGLE：暂停单个任务
description.en:
The type of the pause operation. Valid values:

*   ALL: pauses all SQL tasks.
*   SINGLE: pauses a single SQL task.

title.zh: 暂停执行数据变更工单SQL任务

descriptions.zh: 仅管控模式为安全协同的数据库实例可调用此API。
descriptions.en: You can call this operation only for database instances that are managed in Security Collaboration mode.
